follow100Note: Crypto alone supplied $27.18 of every $100 of revenue — $252M of the $927M total — as digital-asset trading doubled from a year ago.
footerNote: Robinhood does not report a separate cost of revenue; 'Brokerage and transaction' — the direct cost of executing customers' trades — is shown as the direct cost here.
otherDetail: Other income, net was $1M — small next to the main business.

segments.name: Transaction-based revenues
segments.note: Fees from customers' trades — crypto $252M, options $240M and equities $56M.

segments.name: Net interest revenues
segments.note: Interest on customers' cash and margin loans, plus securities lending.

segments.name: Other revenues
segments.note: Mostly Robinhood Gold subscriptions — 3.2M subscribers, up 90%.

takeaways.text: Transaction revenue rose 77% to $583M — crypto revenue doubled to $252M, options rose 56% to $240M and equities rose 44% to $56M as customers traded actively across asset classes.
takeaways.title: Crypto revenue doubled

takeaways.text: Net deposits hit a record $18.0B in the quarter and total platform assets rose 70% to $221B, helped by the February close of the TradePMR acquisition, which added about $41B of assets managed by advisors on its platform.
takeaways.title: Record net deposits

takeaways.text: Robinhood Gold subscribers rose 90% to a record 3.2M, lifting other revenues 54% to $54M — steady subscription income growing alongside the trading business.
takeaways.title: Gold subscribers hit a record

verdict: Robinhood's revenue rose 50% to $927M as crypto revenue doubled and options trading surged — and profit more than doubled to $336M as revenue growth outpaced a 21% rise in spending.
